sections.description:
A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that prevented some players from receiving the Captured and Delivery Interruption reward sprays after completing the achievement requirements

- [CHINA] Fixed a bug that prevented some players from receiving the Captured and Delivery Interruption reward sprays after completing the achievement requirements
blocks.dev: Players who have successfully earned the achievement will receive the reward sprays immediately next time they log in.
